tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Find remote, hybrid and on-site jobs across feeds and employer boards. Combine role, company, country, city or region, work mode, source, date window and annual salary target. Returns paginated, deduplicated leads with links, evidence and source coverage.

tools.name: search_employer_boards
tools.description: Search current public postings from a supported employer’s careers board. Returns job links, requisition IDs and location metadata. Use this to check a specific employer directly.
